scope: Three additional directly read performed preparations, with general procedures checked and independently transcribed named structures. Source heading errors, racemate status and absence of yield/isolated intermediate characterization remain explicit.

records.checked_passage: To 3-chloroisonicotinic acid (413 mg, 2.62 mmol) was added thionyl chloride (5 mL, 68.5 mmol).
records.locator: Exemplification of General Procedure F, second acid-chloride preparation, normalized offset about536232. Heading mistakenly repeats 3-methyl-isonicotinoyl Chloride; actual substrate and resulting product explicitly name 3-chloro.
records.source_conditions: 3-Chloroisonicotinic acid 413 mg/2.62 mmol and thionyl chloride 5 mL/68.5 mmol, room temperature about20 h. Concentrated under reduced pressure and high vacuum1 h to give the acid chloride. No substrate-specific isolated yield or independent acid-chloride characterization is stated; generic DCM/3-equivalent conditions are not substituted for this actual example.
records.experimental_product_status: Performed and named acid-chloride preparation, dried residue; not claimed analytically characterized or isolated pure. Subsequent oxadiazole yields do not describe this intermediate.
records.structural_reconciliation: Isonicotinic acid has carboxyl at pyridine C4 and chlorine at C3; only carboxylic OH becomes Cl. Independent N-first pyridine traversal preserves these positions. The repeated methyl heading is not used to assign a methyl substituent against the explicit chloro substrate/product in the body.
